Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
Urinalysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, positive nitrites, and >100,000 CFU/mL E. coli, indicating a urinary tract infection. Presence of hematuria and mild proteinuria may be secondary to infection. Low specific gravity could reflect dilute urine. No ketones or casts detected. Recommend clinical correlation and appropriate antibiotic therapy.
